description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) EIP-1967/Beacon proxy slot inspector and verified Solidity source resolver. Probes on-chain implementation, admin, beacon, owner(), and paused() states via AsyncWeb3 and retrieves verified source metadata from Sourcify/Etherscan v2 without invoking any LLM. Supports offline_mode=True for deterministic dry-run or network-free verification.

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia, 42161 for Arbitrum One)

fetch_verified_source.description: Whether to query Sourcify/Etherscan v2 for verified Solidity source metadata

offline_mode.description: If true, returns a deterministic clean offline structure without making RPC or HTTP calls

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract or proxy to inspect

name: inspect_proxy_and_source
